newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan to auction T$50 bln in govt bonds on Dec 17.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan to auction T$50 bln in govt bonds on Dec 17.

text.p: Taiwan's finance ministry said on Tuesday it would auction T$50 billion in government bonds on December 17 to bridge a shortage of central government funds.
The bonds, to be issued on December 20, would have a 10-year term and a coupon rate of 6.80 percent, the ministry said in a statement.
The ministry had said the T$50 billion issue would be the largest single issue in value in five years.

"Facing the serious shortage of central government income and a spending peak....(the finance ministry) plans to issue T$50 billion in government bonds in December," the ministry said early on Friday.
The issue dates were announced later in the day.
The ministry also plans to issue an undecided amount of treasury bills at an "appropriate time" to cope with the state demand for money, the statement said.
